description: Schema for representing medical information for a patient

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format

sex.description: The sex of patient represented as F or M

primaryInsuranceName.description: The name of the primary insurance of the patient

primaryInsuranceType.description: The type of the primary insurance of the patient

primaryInsuranceMemberID.description: The member ID number of the primary insurance of the patient

primaryInsuranceGroupID.description: The group ID number of the primary insurance of the patient

secondaryInsuranceName.description: The name of the secondary insurance of the patient

secondaryInsuranceType.description: The type of the secondary insurance of the patient

secondaryInsuranceMemberID.description: The member ID number of the secondary insurance of the patient

secondaryInsuranceGroupID.description: The group ID number of the secondary insurance of the patient

CPTCodes.description: The one or more CPT Codes of the patient

ICDCodes.description: The one or more ICD Codes of the patient
